rows.label: tlk70000009_03_msg0001
rows.name:
The capital has regained its peaceful
appearance now, but...

rows.label: tlk70000009_03_msg0002
rows.name:
It took everything I could muster
just to dodge the enemies' attacks
and deliver word to the main forces.

rows.label: tlk70000009_03_msg0003
rows.name:
Now I see why elite soldiers are
posted at this watchtower. It gets
attacked before help comes.

rows.label: tlk70000009_03_msg0004
rows.name: There was no room to fight...

rows.label: tlk70000009_03_msg0005
rows.name:
It's a whole lot harder than
guarding the gate, I can tell you.

rows.label: tlk70000009_03_msg0006
rows.name:
I think I was conceited. I'd just been
promoted and imagined I could do more
than my actual ability allowed.

rows.label: tlk70000009_03_msg0007
rows.name:
No wonder my older brother keeps
fussing over me...

rows.label: tlk70000009_03_msg0008
rows.name:
Damn it! I need to spend more time
training!
